opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for a return or one-way flight from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} (and {return_date}) for {adults} adults, optionally applying {promo_code}, then select the outbound and return fares.
steps: Open ryanair.com Flights tab
Pick Return trip or One way
Click From, then pick the origin country and airport (or type the city)
Click To, then pick the destination country and airport (or type the city)
Open the depart calendar, go to the month and click the depart date
If it's a return trip, click the return date
Open Passengers and set the adult count, then click Done
Optionally click Apply promo code and type the code
Click Search
On the results page click Select for the outbound flight, then for the return flight

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search for {destination/attraction} on {date}, optionally apply filters and sort, open {attraction} and pick ticket counts for that date.
steps: Click Attractions in the Booking.com header
Type the attraction or city in 'Where are you going?' and pick the suggestion (or choose a city from Explore more destinations by region)
Click Select your dates and pick the date
Click Search
Optionally tick filters (Free cancellation, City, Category) and choose a sort tab (Most popular)
Open the attraction / click See availability
Confirm the date on the attraction page if needed
Set the number of Adult / Child / Infant tickets with the +/- buttons
Click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May 2023, ticket selection opened
Kyoto (Asia), 25 May 2023, filters Free cancellation + City Kyoto + Tours, sorted Most popular, Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and set Notify alert
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for {query}, open {restaurant}, set {date} and {guests}, then set a Notify for {lunch/dinner} with an optional preferred time window.
steps: In the Resy search box, type the cuisine or restaurant name
Click the matching restaurant in the suggestions
Optionally change the date picker and Guests dropdown
Click Notify for the meal period you want (Lunch/Dinner)
Optionally set the preferred start and end times
Click Confirm
